annotations.text:
Focusblocks - simple Pomodoro web app (2 pages).

Timer: 3 modes (Pomodoro / Short / Long Break) + circular countdown. Below, today's session log: auto S.No / Task / Block.

Report: sessions per day + a table sortable by Block (shown grouped by Block).

Static hi-fi mockups, one direction. 'Block' = a category you tag each session with (Deep Work / Admin / Learning). Name + sample data are placeholders.
